summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (stdlib os/json only, private _resolve_path helper, ValueError on all failures), exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was committed. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run per instructions; formatting was checked only by measuring line lengths (none over 120). Choices made: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; base_dir is Optional[str]; lines fitting in 120 columns were kept on one line.
